# has opening hours

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasOpeningHours`](gmeow-hasOpeningHours.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasOpeningHours>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

Relates an offering (or the org/place behind it) to an opening-hours window. Non-functional: several windows coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) -> [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](../classes/gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md)
